text:
Scientists use machine learning models to answer scientific questions.

You have access to seismic data collected around Anchorage and a machine learning model that can help you identify signals. In other words, you have the same tools as geoscientists! In this lesson, you will explore the data to discover patterns in seismic data.

The question you will use ML to answer is: In what month in the past 5 years has Anchorage experienced the most earthquakes?

Plan your method for answering this question using ML. Describe how you will use the WaveRunner and Timeline to answer the questions in Challenge 1 to plan your investigation.
